Title: Gentlemen affiliate Azazel (LEAKNED) - ipv4
Description: Azazel's victim-facing command-and-control server: Penelope reverse shell sessions, an HTTP upload listener on port 9999 receiving stolen data, and the open directory on port 8000 that exposed the operation. Source: CloudSEK – Caught in 4K: The Gentlemen Files https://www.cloudsek.com/blog/caught-in-4k-the-gentlemen-files
RecommendedActions: Isolate host, investigate process tree and persistence; rotate credentials if confirmed.
